sources.title: Chamber of Commerce of the State of New York, Rapid Transit in New York City and in the Other Great Cities (1906), ch. 4 "Bridges to Brooklyn" (the Blackwell's Island bridge)

towerHeightM.note: height (P2048): the tower finials above the water

totalLengthM.note: length (P2043) of the cantilever structure; the five spans below add up to it

shoreSpanWestM.note: "a shore span on the Manhattan side, 469.5 feet in length"

islandSpanM.note: "a central span across the island of 630 feet"

trussDepthAtTowersM.note: "the height between the chords at the towers will be 185 feet"

trussDepthMidM.note: truss depth mid-span and at the anchor piers, proportioned by eye

deckClearanceM.note: the deck (bottom chord) above the water, about the East River bridges' 135 ft

deckWidthM.note: the deck between the truss walls (the S07a kit's stylised width)

finialM.note: tower height - deck clearance - truss depth at the towers, so the finials top out at the Wikidata height

towerLeg.note: each steel tower leg's section over a pier

pier.note: the masonry piers (the S07a kit's stylised plan)

pierTopM.note: the masonry piers' top above the water

readabilityScale.note: Truss chords and members are drawn this many times a real member's width so the lattice reads; panels are drawn longer than the real ones.

gameScale.note: Game scale (orchestrator decision 2026-10-08, the user may overrule): heights x1.8 and widths x1.8 against the real numbers above (1.8 keeps the deck inside the frame's 56 m exclusion), so the bridge reads at the 3,000-4,500 m game camera. Lengths along the axis stay real.
